description: Runs SQL over CSV, TSV, JSON, NDJSON, Parquet, XLSX and ODS files, a folder of them, or rows sent inline, with exact types, and saves a result as CSV or Parquet, as a Data analyst agent and one plugin.

inference_slots.description: Explores the data files the user names with the data_tables tool and answers from SQL results. Any capable profile.
inference_slots.name: data_analyst

name: data_tables

bind_dir.description: The folder holding the data files, or the one data file to query; a call that sets output also writes the result file into the folder

plugins.description: Runs SQL (Apache DataFusion) over CSV, TSV, JSON, NDJSON, Parquet, XLSX and ODS files, a folder of them, or inline rows: lists tables, describes columns with statistics, returns query results with exact types, stable paging and a Markdown table, and with output writes the whole result as a CSV or Parquet file in the folder.

columns.description: For describe: the columns to report, at most 200; default the first 200.

cursor.description: The next.cursor value of the previous call, to continue it. Repeat every other field unchanged (max_rows may change).

delimiter.description: The CSV field delimiter, one character or tab; detected when omitted.

files.description: Relative paths inside the folder path to use as tables, in this order; without it every readable file below path is a table.

header.description: Whether the first CSV row is a header; detected when omitted.

markdown_rows.description: The most rows shown in the Markdown table.

max_bytes.description: The most bytes of row data one page returns; the whole result stays under 3.5 MB, so a page may hold fewer rows and then carries next.cursor.

max_rows.description: The most rows one page returns.

mode.description: tables lists the tables and their columns; describe adds statistics and sample rows; query runs sql. Default: query with sql, else tables.

path.description: Path of the data file or folder; a relative path starts at the working folder. Without it only inline tables are available.

path_original.description: Set by the host to the real path of the file or folder named in path; leave it out.

sample_rows.description: For describe: how many rows the statistics read.

sql.description: One SELECT to run (at most 64 KiB). Names keep their case; quote names with spaces.

table.description: For tables and describe: only this table.

tables.description: Rows sent inline: a list of {name, columns, rows} tables, one such table, or an object of name to rows. Rows are lists or objects; columns may declare types.

format.description: The file format; taken from output when it ends in .csv or .parquet.

output.description: Write the whole result of sql to this file in the folder path instead of returning rows, such as result.csv: a plain name, no folders, not starting with a dot. Only a call with output writes.

overwrite.description: Replace output when it already exists; otherwise an existing file is an error.

plugins.name: data_tables
